reuse.why: Adds the check inside the existing linkBankSyncAccount and reuses the account row it already loads.

duplication.why: No logic is repeated; the account lookup is hoisted rather than repeated.

placement.why: The rule sits in the single shared link function, next to the existing one-link-per-bank-account check, ahead of any side effects.

scope.why: Only the shared link function, focused tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Small, well-ordered change that every provider inherits automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: all provider link handlers go through linkBankSyncAccount

one_place.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link handlers
